gripOrHq.title: Shock.r
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

gripOrHq.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: Project Consultants
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Security Net Optimization
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a fort when scored. Ice installed on that fort gets +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Roving Submarine
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Install only inside a subsidiary data fort. This fort may be run only if you installed or advanced a card inside or on this fort during your last turn.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: ACME Savings and Loan
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.
